variables.description: Named variables whose meaning must be bound to table evidence.

population.description: Population and inclusion scope of the requested analysis.

unit.description: Logical observational unit, such as person, transaction or day.

target.description: Outcome concept to predict, explain or estimate.

features.description: Predictors or descriptive features with a declared information-availability policy.

prediction_time.description: Point at which the prediction would be made; not necessarily a time-series column.

time_axis.description: Temporal ordering field and its meaning.

horizon.description: Requested forecast distance from the prediction origin.

duration.description: Time origin and event/censoring duration definition.

method.description: Explicit or separately reviewed procedure choice; never inferred solely from keywords.

statistic.description: Requested descriptive statistic or aggregation function.

condition.description: Explicit row-selection predicate and its null semantics.

order.description: Sort direction, tie policy and ordering semantics.

count.description: Requested number of outputs, not a statistical adequacy threshold.

reference.description: Reference population, period, distribution, rule or baseline.

confidence_level.description: Declared uncertainty-interval level; no default invented.

design.description: Sampling, dependence or experimental design and supporting documentation.

treatment.description: Intervention or exposure, including control contrast.

adjustment.description: Adjustment/identification specification justified by domain evidence.

model.description: Identified model artifact, version, task and preprocessing contract.

objective.description: Decision objective with direction and interpretation.

tables.description: Identified input table set; unresolved references require clarification.

mapping.description: Schema, entity, unit or field mapping with provenance.

rules.description: Validation or transformation rules with provenance.

missing_policy.description: Explicit handling of missing values and its assumptions.

expression.description: Declared derived-value expression and unit semantics.

shape.description: Requested long/wide representation and value/key roles.

sample_design.description: Sampling unit, selection scheme and size/precision objective.

region.description: Named spatial area or boundary geometry.

distance.description: Distance metric, units and requested bound.

edges.description: Graph relation identities, direction and weights.

entities.description: Entity types or mentions requested for extraction.

display.description: Requested visual encoding, audience or presentation constraint.

generative_model.description: Specified simulator or structural model with assumptions.

compare.definition: Descriptively contrast comparable observations of one numerical measure.
compare.selection: Comparison goal; insufficient specificity is preserved rather than forced into a child.

compare.groups.definition: Compare a numerical measure across specified groups.
compare.groups.selection: At least two groups and a measure; a time filter alone does not imply trajectories.
exclusions: Direct observed numerical comparison only; no aggregation, joins, statistical inference or causal claims.
examples: Compare the annual recorded income of France and Spain in 2021.

compare.groups.trajectories.definition: Compare temporal change of the same measure across groups.
compare.groups.trajectories.selection: Explicit temporal change or trajectory comparison across groups, with resolvable time points and grain.
exclusions: Direct observed numerical comparison only; no aggregation, joins, statistical inference or causal claims.
examples: Compare annual income trajectories of France and Spain at 2019 and 2021.

compare.time.definition: Compare one subject across explicit time points.
compare.time.selection: One subject and a measure, explicitly contrasted across time.
exclusions: Direct observed numerical comparison only; no aggregation, joins, statistical inference or causal claims.
examples: Compare annual income in France in 2019 versus 2021.

retrieve.definition: Look up or select existing observations.
retrieve.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

summarize.definition: Describe observed data without inferential or causal claims.
summarize.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

aggregate.definition: Compute explicitly specified statistics over observations.
aggregate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

associate.definition: Describe statistical relationships without causal interpretation.
associate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

predict.definition: Predict unknown outcomes under an explicit task and information policy.
predict.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

cluster.definition: Discover groups under a declared representation and similarity policy.
cluster.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

detect.definition: Identify unusual observations or changes relative to a specified reference.
detect.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

explain.definition: Explain associations, model behavior or causation with distinct evidence contracts.
explain.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

test.definition: Evaluate a stated statistical hypothesis with a justified design.
test.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

estimate.definition: Estimate population quantities and uncertainty under a stated design.
estimate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

monitor.definition: Track indicators or distribution changes against a declared baseline.
monitor.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

integrate.definition: Combine or align table evidence with explicit multi-table semantics.
integrate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

prepare.definition: Prepare tabular observations using explicit, provenance-preserving rules.
prepare.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

validate.definition: Assess data validity against explicit rules.
validate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

visualize.definition: Present observed data through a declared visual encoding.
visualize.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

recommend.definition: Suggest eligible items under a stated preference objective.
recommend.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

optimize.definition: Choose feasible decisions against declared objectives.
optimize.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

simulate.definition: Explore conditional scenarios using an explicit model.
simulate.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

spatial.definition: Analyze spatial relations using defined coordinate and distance semantics.
spatial.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

network.definition: Analyze graph structure represented by tables.
network.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

text.definition: Analyze text-valued table fields under explicit language and task definitions.
text.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

discover.definition: Find tables or compatible data assets for a stated information need.
discover.selection: Family only: preserve ambiguity until a concrete subtype and its required arguments are resolved.

retrieve.lookup.definition: Retrieve values for identified observational units.
retrieve.lookup.selection: Retrieve values for identified observational units. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not infer missing values or perform unstated aggregation.
examples: Find the recorded revenue for shop A on 2024-01-01.

retrieve.filter.selection: Select rows satisfying explicit conditions. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Filtering is not a claim about an unobserved population.
examples: Select transactions above 100 euros with known payment status.

retrieve.sort.definition: Order observed records using declared ordering and ties.
retrieve.sort.selection: Order observed records using declared ordering and ties. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not compare incompatible units.
examples: Sort recorded deliveries by duration ascending, retaining ties.

retrieve.top_k.definition: Find extrema or top-k observations under a specified order.
retrieve.top_k.selection: Find extrema or top-k observations under a specified order. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No unstated utility function or statistical significance.
examples: Find the five highest recorded daily sales, retaining boundary ties.

summarize.profile.definition: Describe schema, missingness and observed field properties.
summarize.profile.selection: Describe schema, missingness and observed field properties. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: A profile does not establish fitness for an analytical use.
examples: Profile the types and missing values of age and income.

summarize.distribution.definition: Describe an observed distribution and its support.
summarize.distribution.selection: Describe an observed distribution and its support. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No population generalization without a sampling design.
examples: Describe the observed distribution of delivery times.

summarize.statistics.definition: Compute specified descriptive statistics on observed values.
summarize.statistics.selection: Compute specified descriptive statistics on observed values. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not silently substitute mean for median.
examples: Report the median observed transaction amount.

aggregate.grouped.definition: Compute a specified measure statistic within explicit groups.
aggregate.grouped.selection: Compute a specified measure statistic within explicit groups. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Does not enable aggregate-then-compare in the current runtime.
examples: Compute total recorded sales by store.

aggregate.count.definition: Count records or entities using a declared counting unit.
aggregate.count.selection: Count records or entities using a declared counting unit. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Row counts and distinct-entity counts are different tasks.
examples: Count distinct customers with purchases during 2024.

aggregate.temporal.definition: Aggregate a measure to an explicit temporal grain.
aggregate.temporal.selection: Aggregate a measure to an explicit temporal grain. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Missing periods and partial periods must be explicit.
examples: Compute total recorded sales for each calendar month.

associate.correlation.definition: Measure association between paired numerical variables.
associate.correlation.selection: Measure association between paired numerical variables. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Correlation is not causation; constant-variable handling is method-specific.
examples: Measure Pearson correlation between height and weight for the same adults.

associate.categorical.definition: Assess observed association between categorical variables.
associate.categorical.selection: Assess observed association between categorical variables. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not infer causal effects from contingency counts.
examples: Describe association between product category and return status.

associate.conditional.definition: Describe association conditional on specified variables.
associate.conditional.selection: Describe association conditional on specified variables. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Adjustment alone does not establish causal identification.
examples: Describe the income-education association conditional on age.

predict.classification.definition: Predict a categorical outcome for new observational units.
predict.classification.selection: Predict a categorical outcome for new observational units. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not require a time-series column or imply predictive accuracy.
examples: Predict customer churn status from information available at signup.

predict.regression.definition: Predict a numerical outcome for new observational units.
predict.regression.selection: Predict a numerical outcome for new observational units. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Post-sale fields and target-derived features are leakage.
examples: Predict sale price from property features available before listing.

predict.forecasting.definition: Forecast a numerical series beyond an explicit prediction origin.
predict.forecasting.selection: Forecast a numerical series beyond an explicit prediction origin. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Forecasting is distinct from generic supervised prediction; no silent cadence.
examples: Forecast daily rental counts for the next seven days from history ending yesterday.

predict.survival.definition: Predict time to a defined event with censoring-aware follow-up.
predict.survival.selection: Predict time to a defined event with censoring-aware follow-up. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not treat censored times as observed failure times.
examples: Predict time to equipment failure using installation-time features and censored follow-up.

cluster.partition.definition: Partition observations under a declared feature representation.
cluster.partition.selection: Partition observations under a declared feature representation. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Clusters are not pre-existing labeled classes.
examples: Group customers by purchase behavior using a reviewed scaled feature representation.

cluster.density.definition: Identify dense groups and noise under a declared neighborhood policy.
cluster.density.selection: Identify dense groups and noise under a declared neighborhood policy. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Noise labels are not automatically erroneous records.
examples: Find dense spatial groups of incidents using a specified distance policy.

detect.anomaly.definition: Identify observations unusual relative to a declared reference.
detect.anomaly.selection: Identify observations unusual relative to a declared reference. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: An outlier is not proof of fraud or error.
examples: Flag transactions unusual relative to a reviewed historical reference.

detect.change.definition: Identify changes in an ordered process relative to a reference.
detect.change.selection: Identify changes in an ordered process relative to a reference. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not infer the cause of a detected change.
examples: Find changes in the daily demand process relative to last year's baseline.

explain.association.definition: Describe observed factors associated with an outcome.
explain.association.selection: Describe observed factors associated with an outcome. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Associational explanation must not be called causal.
examples: Describe which recorded features are associated with churn.

explain.model.definition: Explain outputs of an identified predictive model.
explain.model.selection: Explain outputs of an identified predictive model. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Model attribution is not a causal explanation of the world.
examples: Explain which features influence this versioned model's churn predictions.

explain.causal.definition: Estimate an explicitly defined causal contrast under a reviewed design.
explain.causal.selection: Estimate an explicitly defined causal contrast under a reviewed design. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Columns and correlations alone cannot establish identification.
examples: Estimate the effect of randomized treatment assignment on the stated outcome.

test.difference.definition: Test a stated difference under a declared sampling/dependence design.
test.difference.selection: Test a stated difference under a declared sampling/dependence design. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Descriptive Compare does not imply this inferential procedure.
examples: Test the predeclared difference in mean response between two randomized groups.

test.independence.definition: Test a stated independence hypothesis for paired variables.
test.independence.selection: Test a stated independence hypothesis for paired variables. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not choose the hypothesis after inspecting significance.
examples: Test the predeclared independence of category and outcome for sampled units.

test.goodness_of_fit.definition: Test compatibility with a stated reference distribution.
test.goodness_of_fit.selection: Test compatibility with a stated reference distribution. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Failure to reject is not proof of distributional identity.
examples: Test the predeclared fit of waiting times to a specified distribution.

estimate.parameter.definition: Estimate a specified population quantity under a sampling design.
estimate.parameter.selection: Estimate a specified population quantity under a sampling design. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No unsupported extrapolation to a different population.
examples: Estimate mean commute duration for the sampled population using declared weights.

estimate.interval.definition: Quantify uncertainty for a specified estimand and interval level.
estimate.interval.selection: Quantify uncertainty for a specified estimand and interval level. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: A confidence interval is not a predictive interval for an individual.
examples: Estimate a 95 percent interval for the stated population mean.

monitor.threshold.definition: Track a defined indicator against an explicit threshold rule.
monitor.threshold.selection: Track a defined indicator against an explicit threshold rule. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No silent alert threshold or guarantee of future service.
examples: Monitor recorded daily error rate against the declared service threshold.

monitor.drift.definition: Track distribution changes between reference and current windows.
monitor.drift.selection: Track distribution changes between reference and current windows. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Input drift alone does not prove performance degradation.
examples: Monitor feature-distribution drift against the frozen training window.

integrate.join.definition: Combine tables through a specified relational join.
integrate.join.selection: Combine tables through a specified relational join. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Multi-table operation; a single table cannot certify the other side.
examples: Join orders to customers by the documented customer key.

integrate.union.definition: Append compatible rows from mapped source schemas.
integrate.union.selection: Append compatible rows from mapped source schemas. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Matching column names alone do not prove compatibility.
examples: Append monthly exports after verifying matching columns and units.

integrate.entity_resolution.definition: Link records referring to the same real-world entities.
integrate.entity_resolution.selection: Link records referring to the same real-world entities. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Similarity alone is not verified identity.
examples: Link organization records using reviewed identifiers and linkage rules.

prepare.clean.definition: Apply declared correction or normalization rules.
prepare.clean.selection: Apply declared correction or normalization rules. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not silently change meanings or invent corrected values.
examples: Normalize country codes using a versioned mapping.

prepare.deduplicate.definition: Resolve duplicates under a declared entity and retention policy.
prepare.deduplicate.selection: Resolve duplicates under a declared entity and retention policy. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Equal rows are not always duplicate real-world events.
examples: Deduplicate customer records by verified IDs and an explicit retention rule.

prepare.impute.definition: Handle missing values using a declared imputation policy.
prepare.impute.selection: Handle missing values using a declared imputation policy. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Imputed values remain inferred, not observed facts.
examples: Impute missing predictors using the specified training-only procedure.

prepare.derive.definition: Compute derived fields using an explicit expression.
prepare.derive.selection: Compute derived fields using an explicit expression. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Guard units, zero denominators and propagated missingness.
examples: Derive unit price from documented revenue and quantity columns.

prepare.reshape.definition: Reshape tables while preserving keys and measure meaning.
prepare.reshape.selection: Reshape tables while preserving keys and measure meaning. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No silent aggregation of duplicate key cells.
examples: Reshape annual columns into a long year-value table using the declared keys.

prepare.sample.definition: Select observations under an explicit sampling design.
prepare.sample.selection: Select observations under an explicit sampling design. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Convenience samples do not become representative by size alone.
examples: Select a stratified sample using the stated strata and inclusion scheme.

validate.schema.definition: Check a table against a specified schema contract.
validate.schema.selection: Check a table against a specified schema contract. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Schema validity is not analytical usefulness.
examples: Check required columns and declared data types.

validate.quality.definition: Check declared data-quality rules in their scope.
validate.quality.selection: Check declared data-quality rules in their scope. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not invent acceptable missingness thresholds.
examples: Check uniqueness and missingness against the supplied validation rules.

visualize.distribution.definition: Display observed values using an appropriate distribution encoding.
visualize.distribution.selection: Display observed values using an appropriate distribution encoding. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not silently transform or omit outliers.
examples: Plot the distribution of observed delivery durations with declared bins.

visualize.relationship.definition: Display relationships between bound observed variables.
visualize.relationship.selection: Display relationships between bound observed variables. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Visual association is not causal evidence.
examples: Plot height against weight for the same sampled adults.

visualize.temporal.definition: Display observations over an explicit temporal axis.
visualize.temporal.selection: Display observations over an explicit temporal axis. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Do not interpolate missing observations without disclosure.
examples: Plot recorded daily counts with missing dates shown explicitly.

recommend.items.definition: Rank eligible items for a recipient under a preference objective.
recommend.items.selection: Rank eligible items for a recipient under a preference objective. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Predicted preference is not guaranteed benefit or causal uplift.
examples: Recommend eligible products using reviewed preference evidence.

optimize.allocation.definition: Choose feasible resource allocations for a declared objective.
optimize.allocation.selection: Choose feasible resource allocations for a declared objective. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Observed correlations do not identify controllable interventions.
examples: Allocate staffing subject to explicit capacity and coverage constraints.

optimize.multiobjective.definition: Identify tradeoffs among multiple explicit objectives.
optimize.multiobjective.selection: Identify tradeoffs among multiple explicit objectives. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: No hidden objective weights or universally best solution.
examples: Find feasible cost-service tradeoffs under declared constraints.

simulate.scenario.definition: Generate outcomes conditional on a model and scenario assumptions.
simulate.scenario.selection: Generate outcomes conditional on a model and scenario assumptions. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Scenario output is conditional, not an observed outcome or proven causal effect.
examples: Simulate demand under a stated scenario using the supplied model.

simulate.sensitivity.definition: Assess output sensitivity to explicitly varied model inputs.
simulate.sensitivity.selection: Assess output sensitivity to explicitly varied model inputs. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Sensitivity is not identification or predictive validation.
examples: Vary the declared model inputs over specified ranges and inspect sensitivity.

spatial.proximity.definition: Evaluate distances or proximity with explicit spatial semantics.
spatial.proximity.selection: Evaluate distances or proximity with explicit spatial semantics. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Latitude-longitude degree distance is not automatically metric distance.
examples: Find facilities within five kilometers using the declared coordinate system.

spatial.region.definition: Select or summarize observations within defined spatial boundaries.
spatial.region.selection: Select or summarize observations within defined spatial boundaries. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Boundary and point-in-polygon conventions must be explicit.
examples: Find observations inside the versioned municipal boundary.

network.paths.definition: Find paths under declared edge direction and cost semantics.
network.paths.selection: Find paths under declared edge direction and cost semantics. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Connectivity is not proof of physical or causal reachability.
examples: Find the shortest route under the supplied edge-cost definition.

network.communities.definition: Describe graph communities under a declared method.
network.communities.selection: Describe graph communities under a declared method. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Algorithmic communities are not verified social categories.
examples: Find communities in the stated interaction graph.

text.classification.definition: Assign declared semantic categories to text-valued observations.
text.classification.selection: Assign declared semantic categories to text-valued observations. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Labels require language/context validation and are model predictions.
examples: Categorize feedback using the supplied category definitions.

text.extraction.definition: Extract declared entity or attribute types from text fields.
text.extraction.selection: Extract declared entity or attribute types from text fields. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Extracted mentions are not verified external facts.
examples: Extract product mentions with spans from feedback text.

text.summary.definition: Summarize text-valued observations with source traceability.
text.summary.selection: Summarize text-valued observations with source traceability. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: A summary must not invent evidence or imply representativeness.
examples: Summarize recurring feedback themes with cited source records.

discover.topical.definition: Find tables related to an explicit information need.
discover.topical.selection: Find tables related to an explicit information need. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Topical relevance alone does not establish intended usefulness.
examples: Find tables describing municipal transport usage.

discover.compatible.definition: Find candidate tables compatible with a declared integration need.
discover.compatible.selection: Find candidate tables compatible with a declared integration need. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.
exclusions: Candidate compatibility requires both sides' evidence, not schema-name similarity.
examples: Find tables that can join to the specified orders table by customer identity.

measure_semantics.definition: Requested concept matches the bound measure, supported by semantic evidence.
measure_semantics.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

observation_binding.definition: All supplied roles refer to the same logical observation relation and measure.
observation_binding.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

group_coverage.definition: Every requested group occurs in the bound relation within requested context.
group_coverage.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

time_coverage.definition: Every requested time point occurs within supplied group or subject scope and grain.
time_coverage.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

paired_temporal_support.definition: At least two shared time points have observations for every requested group.
paired_temporal_support.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

complete_requested_grid.definition: Every requested group-time cell is represented.
complete_requested_grid.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

usable_numeric_observations.definition: Required observations have finite usable numeric values, without unresolved conflicting duplicates.
usable_numeric_observations.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

comparable_measure_definition.definition: Units, measure definitions and applicable population/denominator definitions are documented as compatible across compared observations.
comparable_measure_definition.evidence_contract: Bound profile claims with provenance, inspection completeness and scope. Missing evidence is unknown.

concept_binding.definition: Requested variables and concepts have documented table bindings.

evidence_contract.supported: Cited schema/data dictionary and scoped values support each bound concept.
evidence_contract.violated: Authoritative definitions establish a different concept or population.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

unit_binding.definition: Fields refer to the same declared observational units or explicitly related units.

evidence_contract.supported: Row identity and documented keys establish the requested relation.
evidence_contract.violated: Documented grain or pairing conflicts with the requested unit.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

scope_coverage.definition: Evidence covers the requested population and analysis scope.

evidence_contract.supported: A complete scoped scan and source documentation establish requested coverage.
evidence_contract.violated: Complete inspection or authoritative documentation establishes incompatible coverage.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

usable_values.definition: Values are usable under the declared procedure and missing-value policy.

evidence_contract.supported: Relevant values, types and missingness meet the declared procedure contract.
evidence_contract.violated: Observed invalid values contradict the declared handling contract.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

procedure_assumptions.definition: Procedure-specific assumptions and design are reviewed with explicit evidence.

evidence_contract.supported: Documented procedure/design checks support applicability; no universal sample minimum is assumed.
evidence_contract.violated: A documented design or assumption conflict rules out this procedure.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

selection_evaluable.definition: Selection predicates resolve to fields and explicit null/comparison semantics.

evidence_contract.supported: Bindings, domains and null policy permit evaluating the complete predicate.
evidence_contract.violated: The predicate cannot be evaluated under the documented schema or domain.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

ordering_evaluable.definition: Ordering and ties are defined over comparable values.

evidence_contract.supported: Comparable domains and explicit order/tie policy support ranking.
evidence_contract.violated: Mixed incompatible units or domains contradict the requested ordering.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

aggregation_valid.definition: Aggregation function matches measure semantics, units and grouping grain.

evidence_contract.supported: Documented additive/nonadditive meaning and group keys justify the requested statistic.
evidence_contract.violated: The requested operation contradicts measure semantics or combines incompatible groups.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

paired_values.definition: Association variables are paired on the same units within scope.

evidence_contract.supported: A common row/key relation binds all variables without spurious pairing.
evidence_contract.violated: Different populations or unmatched units invalidate the proposed pairing.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

target_observed.definition: Learning target outcomes and label definitions are observed for the learning task.

evidence_contract.supported: Target observations, provenance and target definitions are available in training evidence.
evidence_contract.violated: Documented absence of the target throughout complete training data prevents supervised fitting.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

categorical_target.definition: The target has the declared class semantics.

evidence_contract.supported: A documented finite class domain matches the requested classification task.
evidence_contract.violated: Target meaning is continuous quantity rather than the requested class definition.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

numeric_target.definition: The target is the requested numerical outcome with meaningful units.

evidence_contract.supported: Target definitions and finite observations establish the numerical quantity.
evidence_contract.violated: A categorical identifier or incompatible measure is being used as a numerical target.
evidence_contract.unresolved: Missing, sampled-only negative, ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains unresolved.
evidence_contract.verdict_evidence_refs: Every verdict cites inspected evidence or an explicit missing-evidence record.

feature_availability.definition: Predictor information is available at the declared prediction point.

evidence_contract.supported: Timestamp/provenance or domain documentation establishes pre-prediction availability.

constraints: Shared bindings must be consistent across requirements.
Complete-grid activation requires derive_explicit_group_time_grid_v1 with all activation conditions supported, including exhaustive coverage scoped to every requested group.
Time points require a declared time grain.
No silent transformations, invented roles, thresholds or AB IDs.
Between X and Y remains ambiguous between endpoints and an interval unless context resolves it; never infer cadence silently.
All new families are catalog definitions, not implemented analytical executors.
Missing evidence remains unresolved; no universal sample-size, class-balance or axis-weight defaults.
Do not interpret associational or model explanations as causal identification.
An unknown request remains unmapped for review; the catalog is not exhaustive.
Two variables/groups is a structural arity requirement, not an empirical sample-size guarantee.

provenance.authoring_basis: Author-designed extension requested by the researcher; conceptual task-taxonomy references are not validation of these predicates.

inputs.time_domain: Resolved finite time points/domain and provenance.
inputs.coverage_scope: Reviewed relation of exhaustive coverage to all requested groups.

conditions.groups: At least two distinct requested groups are resolved with source evidence.
conditions.time_domain: A finite temporal domain is resolved with explicit endpoint/inclusion semantics; preserve unresolved range readings.
conditions.time_grain: The requested temporal granularity is explicit, not inferred from a range or bare year labels.
conditions.exhaustive_coverage: The request explicitly requires every temporal position in that domain at that granularity.
conditions.all_groups_scope: The exhaustive temporal requirement unambiguously applies to every requested group under the same action and temporal domain.

provenance.evidence_refs: Map every activation condition to one or more exact-input evidence IDs; overlapping spans are allowed. Record the source input, action instance, literal coverage expression, resolved bindings, and manual scope review in the example card.

derive_explicit_group_time_grid_v1.on_unresolved: Do not derive complete_grid or activate its template. Preserve ambiguity/missing roles; the system default does not repair unresolved required bindings.
limitations: Declarative research proposal; no executable natural-language grounding is implemented.
Every year alone supplies neither groups, finite domain, nor all-groups scope.
Annual or a date range alone is not exhaustive coverage.
Matching spans and reviewed-condition annotations do not prove semantic entailment.
This is not an AB-M1 interpreter normalization or a table-satisfaction claim.

default_available_observations_v1.activation: Default in this proposal when no supported explicit coverage policy is derived; never evidence of user intent and never a remedy for unresolved bindings.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.
limitations: A summary must not invent evidence or imply representativeness.

discover.topical.direct.definition: Find tables related to an explicit information need.
discover.topical.direct.selection: Find tables related to an explicit information need. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.
limitations: Topical relevance alone does not establish intended usefulness.

discover.compatible.direct.definition: Find candidate tables compatible with a declared integration need.
discover.compatible.direct.selection: Find candidate tables compatible with a declared integration need. Resolve all required roles before choosing this subtype.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.
limitations: Candidate compatibility requires both sides' evidence, not schema-name similarity.

predict.classification.linear_classifier.selection: A reviewed linear classification procedure. Requires explicit method/design review; alternatives are not interchangeable defaults.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.
limitations: Do not require a time-series column or imply predictive accuracy.

predict.classification.tree_classifier.selection: A reviewed tree-based classification procedure. Requires explicit method/design review; alternatives are not interchangeable defaults.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.

predict.regression.linear_regression.selection: A reviewed linear regression procedure. Requires explicit method/design review; alternatives are not interchangeable defaults.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.

predict.forecasting.univariate.definition: A history-only forecasting procedure with explicit origin, grain and horizon.

output_contract.provenance: Preserve input identities, role bindings, method/version and evidence references.
